description: Runs a fixture-backed Web-platform semantics probe for CSS-aware innerText (display:none exclusion). The driver reads output from the self-hosted fixture `/fixtures/l2_round3/fv_cssaware_innertext.html`, and the server-side grader compares it with the checked-in expected answer. The driver grades `#card.innerText` directly and requires the hidden `DRAFT_LEAK_500` text to be absent; `#out` mirrors the same visible text.
title: CSS-aware innerText (display:none exclusion)
